original_test_intent: Perform one approved BMC upgrade or downgrade through the supported WebUI and prove authenticated image acceptance, terminal progress, one expected BMC reset, restored OOB access and unchanged host health.
original_method: Bind the target UI session and compatible signed BMC image, preserve baseline, have an authorized operator submit once, monitor progress/reset/OOB/console and verify final firmware plus platform health.
manual_activity: The owner selects image/direction and recovery; an authorized operator verifies UI session/image, submits once and supervises task/reset/OOB recovery while automation collects evidence.
required_inputs: Selected direction and authenticated image digest/signature
Stable power, independent console and rollback
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval and target/image confirmation
Use trusted HTTPS and protect sessions/secrets
Keep power stable and prohibit concurrent firmware activity
Do not clear logs before baseline
Monitor task, one reset and OOB recovery
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, session, image, direction and compatibility
Preserve baseline and start reset/OOB/console monitoring
Assist evidence capture while operator performs documented UI flow
Verify one reset, restored BMC version and host/device health
Do not confirm unapproved actions, recover autonomously or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve image, direction, window and rollback
Verify UI target and supervise submission/recovery

Exactly one reset and OOB loss/recovery plus console evidence
